title: Seven Corners v4 (math rock / fusion, 7/8)
comment: v4: Rhodes carries the harmony, piano the riff and hits, organ pads B and the climax, guitars step back. Loops bar 40 back into bar 1. Guitar v5: Gtr 2 moved to piano with the ring take notes as heard, original piano, Gtr 2 double, Gtr 1 mutes, and organ dropped.
